stem_book: A small block is connected to one end of two identical massless strings of length 16(2/3) cm each with their other ends fixed to a vertical rod (the lower string makes 60° with the rod, as shown). If the ratio of tensions T₁/T₂ (upper/lower) is 4 : 1, then what will be the angular speed ω of the block? (Take g = 10 m/s².) (a) 10 rad/s (b) 14 rad/s (c) 15 rad/s (d) 20 rad/s
reason: added g = 10 m/s² (ω = 14.1 with g = 10; 14.0 with g = 9.8 — b either way)
work: equilateral triangle, both strings at 60° to rod: (T₁ − T₂)/2 = mg, T₁ + T₂ = mω²ℓ; T₁ = 4T₂ ⇒ ω² = 10g/(3ℓ) = 100/(3/6) = 200 ⇒ ω ≈ 14 rad/s
